The schedule route is over 6th Street and I-94 to the south, exiting at Howard Avenue, traveling east to Howell Avenue and south to the airport. The trip takes about 20 minutes. At one time there was heliconter service but this was discontinued.
The Milwaukee Metropolitan Area is served by the following intercity bus lines: Dadger Coach, Greyhound Lines, Tri-State, Coach, Peoria-Rockford, Wisconsin Coach, Wisconsin-Michigan, and Blue Jay Coaches.
Five major railroads service the metropolitan area:
Chicago, Milwaukee St. Paul and Pacific; Chicago and Northwestern
Transportation Company; Soo Line; and car ferry lines Chessie
System and Grand Trunk Western Railroad. Intercity rail passenger
service is provided by Amtrak. There is no rail service to
General Mitchell Field. The existing Chicago, Milwaukee, St.
Paul and Pacific Railroad passes within one mile west of the
air terminal facilities.
